scope: 教员产品方案 P0/P1补齐与验证
implemented: 原话级来源与暂定、确认、更正、停用及取代记录
目标和复盘变化；停用字段及无来源同义改写不复活
正常答复的主张清单、逐字引语/时点核对及一次有界修复
10个稳定案例定义中9个有限已核事实参照；独立结果证据保持空缺
按答复轮次的自愿反馈与导出删除隔离
手机就近理解与已采纳下一步
现实安全及专业问题路由，不强制历史说教或假装联络
代码、提示词、知识、来源指纹、真实用量及延迟观测；后台只读聚合

public_checkout.skip_reason: 8项可选本地完整PDF/OCR集成，公开源码不含这些资产
public_checkout.bootstrap: 37条核验卡、25条语录、10条登记事件和13条方法规则，独立初始化通过

layered understanding and exact clickable references
actions require explicit acceptance attempts and feedback
rename is text safe and remembered issues remain explicit
archive restore and structured export
listening does not create or execute another action
a new issue uses remembered context only after selection
temporary conversations keep context without browser or server history
stopping a stream allows an immediate new question
mobile notes drawers and compact research menu
deleting an issue clears server state memory and local cache
account isolation and logout have no uncaught browser errors
understanding exposes source excerpts without auto confirmation
confirmation is explicit and correction preserves the old version
inactive information remains inactive across a new answer and reload
answer feedback is optional attributed and does not accept an action
case and claim details preserve limited evidence boundaries
mobile conversation keeps understanding and accepted next step nearby
temporary answers do not submit or advertise persistent feedback
login page desktop and mobile layout
registration and ordinary login
research question, local evidence, network disabled
history restore and follow-up context
network enabled gives candidate evidence

history restores mode and cutoff
modern mode question

stop generation and continue
workspace mobile layout, sidebar and evidence drawer
logout, invalid password, relogin
same-browser user isolation
admin login, configuration validation and save

admin mobile layout and logout

checks.name: real understanding keeps exact user sources
real follow-up respects correction exclusion and optional feedback
real source inquiry does not authenticate an invented quotation
real urgent response prioritizes support without historical tools
real professional response states its capability boundary

manual_review: 用户原话与历史引语分别处理，摘录无权授权伪造作者引语
界面更正后的目标保持，停用预算为未知而非恢复原限制
来源查询以本次检索范围未见、归属待核表述，不推断后人加工或历史不存在
紧迫回应不调用史料/网页工具，不生成行动卡或假称已联络；专业回应说明能力边界
real_provider_acceptance.attempt_notes: 早期尝试出现供应商read timeout，按失败保留后分场景重试；还发现并修复用户摘录误判、未核OCR引语的有界修复和过度归属推断。最终有限样例通过不代表总体语义正确或供应商稳定性。
real_provider_acceptance.raw_transcripts: 仅存本机忽略目录，不发布

evaluation_materials.default_validation: 只校验材料结构，不自动调用240轮真实模型或伪造评分
evaluation_materials.pilot: 已准备访谈与2至4周成人试用材料，尚未招募或开展真人试用

release_inventory.scope: 实际Git索引，包括DOCX XML；常见凭据、私有状态、本机路径及体积检查

limits: 主张检查覆盖显式引用及可识别引语，不证明任意转述蕴含或现代建议有效
历史案例尚无独立结果证据，不称完整成功案例；额外内容核验与人工复核仍需继续
长期效果、100次以上的延迟基线及真人试用仍待实际开展
语音、主动回访与公开服务的运营条件按方案后续阶段验证；应用不实施联络或监护
临时对话不保存于本应用；所配置外部模型与搜索服务仍会处理发送内容
